name: Valentina Morales
bio:
Valentina's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. Growing up in Santiago, she was drawn to the technical intricacies of rally cars, spending hours watching races with her grandfather, a retired mechanic. This early exposure ignited a passion for understanding how vehicles perform under extreme conditions.

After completing her studies in engineering, Valentina sought an opportunity to combine her technical knowledge with her love of racing. She began as a junior data analyst for a local racing team, quickly impressing her colleagues with her meticulous attention to detail and her ability to translate complex data into actionable insights. At CLRT by Almeras, she thrives on optimizing testing programs to maximize driver performance. Valentina distinguishes herself through her proactive approach to problem-solving and her unwavering commitment to continuous improvement.

In her current role as test driver coordinator, Valentina is the central point of contact between the engineering team, the drivers, and the workshop. She ensures all testing sessions are meticulously planned, executed, and analyzed, translating driver feedback into actionable improvements for the car. She is driven by a desire to extract every last bit of performance, and will work tirelessly to improve the team.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair, often tied back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Valentina is of average height with a lean, athletic build.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten notes and sketches.
Has a habit of tapping her pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
Prefers to conduct meetings standing up to encourage efficiency.
